newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF says NAV 206 Ffr per share.
newsitem.headline: AGF says NAV 206 Ffr per share.

text.p: Assurances Generales de France said on Thursday that its net asset value at June 30, 1996 stood at 28.1 billion francs or 206 francs per share against 200 francs per share at December 31, 1995.

The company which announced that first half profits rose 48.5 percent to 723 million francs and said the net asset value figure included unrealised capital gains but excluded amounts attributable to policyholders, possible taxes on the realisation of gains and unamortised goodwill.
AGF said its book shareholders' equity after distribution of the 1995 dividend was 23.1 billion francs at the end of the half-year period.
